clue.text: Sleighs with bags on got damaged

indicators.note: something damaged is knocked out of shape, so the letters before it are rearranged

parts.note: the nine letters to be rearranged

explanation.surface: Christmas sleighs loaded with bags have come to grief.
explanation.definitionFit: A toboggan is a long, light sledge, so toboggans are sleighs for sliding over snow.

clue.text: What habitual drinkers do in light opera

indicators.note: in says the answer sits inside the run of words that follows

parts.note: the end of light and the start of opera

explanation.surface: Drinking hard is what happens in an operetta, perhaps a boozy chorus scene.
explanation.definitionFit: To tope is an old verb for drinking alcohol heavily and regularly, which is what a habitual boozer does.

clue.text: Apostle's fine manner evident in play

parts.note: Bartholomew is one of the twelve apostles
fair can mean in a fine, proper manner, as in 'play fair'

explanation.surface: An apostle's good conduct shows in some drama.
explanation.walkthrough: Bartholomew Fair is Ben Jonson's 1614 comedy, set at the London fair held on St Bartholomew's Day.
explanation.definitionFit: Bartholomew Fair is a Jacobean stage comedy by Ben Jonson, so it is a play.

clue.text: What a soldier may be seen wearing in outstanding film

definitions.text: What a soldier may be seen wearing

parts.note: outstanding means great
a film is a thin coat or layer, as of paint

explanation.surface: A war film where the costume department shows off a soldier's uniform.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Film' wants to be a movie; here it is a thin layer.
explanation.definitionFit: A greatcoat is a heavy overcoat, standard military issue for soldiers in cold weather.

clue.text: Join diplomat out East

indicators.note: out says the following letter is dropped from the word

parts.note: a junior embassy official, a French loan word ending in an accented E
E is the compass abbreviation for east

explanation.surface: An instruction to team up with an envoy posted to the Orient.
explanation.definitionFit: To attach is to fasten or connect, a direct synonym of join.

clue.text: Dark piece of ribbon round wide-brimmed hat

parts.note: sombre means dark or gloomy

indicators.note: a piece of the word means only its opening letter is kept

parts.note: the first letter of ribbon
O is round in shape

explanation.surface: A dark band of ribbon goes around the brim of a big hat.
explanation.definitionFit: A sombrero is the broad-brimmed Mexican hat, giving shade from the sun.

clue.text: Overbearing woman ignoring a sign

indicators.note: ignoring means leaving out, so the following letter is dropped from the word

parts.note: a virago is a domineering woman
taken as written

explanation.surface: A bossy woman pays no attention to a warning or signal.
explanation.definitionFit: Virgo is one of the twelve signs of the zodiac, the Virgin.

clue.text: See Irish/American with an infection

parts.note: v. abbreviates Latin vide, meaning see
Ir. is the abbreviation for Irish
US for American

explanation.surface: A doctor sees an Irish-American patient who has caught something.
explanation.definitionFit: A virus is the microscopic agent that causes an infection, and the word is used loosely for the illness itself.

clue.text: New commander on site makes suggestions

indicators.note: new suggests a fresh version, so the letters are made into a different arrangement

parts.note: the fifteen letters to be rearranged

explanation.surface: A newly arrived commander on the ground puts forward some proposals.
explanation.definitionFit: Recommendations are pieces of advice put forward, the same as suggestions.

clue.text: Tournament seeds suggesting a very successful means of achieving a result

definitions.text: a very successful means of achieving a result

parts.note: an open is a tournament anyone may enter, like the British Open
sesame is a plant grown for its small seeds

explanation.surface: Seeded players in a tennis tournament look like a sure route to victory.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Seeds' sounds like ranked players; here it is the plant.
explanation.definitionFit: From Ali Baba's magic password, an open sesame is any sure-fire means of gaining access or success.

clue.text: Number stuck in harbour — that's a bad sign

indicators.note: something stuck in something else sits inside it

parts.note: a port is a harbour
ten is a number

explanation.surface: A ship trapped in harbour is an ominous omen.
explanation.definitionFit: A portent is an omen, usually of something calamitous to come.

clue.text: An amazing event, flea-bitten camel carrying one King

indicators.note: carrying means holding something within
flea-bitten suggests something in a shabby, tattered state, so the word is jumbled

parts.note: the letters to be rearranged
the Roman numeral for one
R for Rex, Latin for king

explanation.surface: A scruffy camel bearing a monarch is a remarkable sight.
explanation.definitionFit: A miracle is an extraordinary, apparently supernatural event that amazes those who witness it.

clue.text: A standard check by chess player is smart playing

parts.note: White is one of the two sides in chess

indicators.note: playing about with the letters means they are moved into new positions

parts.note: ch is the chess notation abbreviation for check
the letters to be rearranged

explanation.surface: A chess game where a routine check is a clever move.
explanation.walkthrough: The clue reads CH next to WHITE in the order the answer needs; 'standard' is a much-recorded popular song.
explanation.definitionFit: Irving Berlin's White Christmas is a classic popular song, the kind performers call a standard.

clue.text: Left one North Dakota doctor lying in bed, blotto

indicators.note: lying in means resting inside, so these pieces sit within the next word

parts.note: a bunk is a bed
L for left
the Roman numeral for one
ND is the postal abbreviation for North Dakota
Dr is the abbreviation for doctor

explanation.surface: A doctor left alone in bed in North Dakota, completely sozzled.
explanation.definitionFit: Blotto is slang for very drunk, as is the idiom blind drunk.

clue.text: Hang work in lounge

parts.note: to loll is to hang down loosely, like a tongue
op. is short for opus, a work

explanation.surface: Pinning up a painting in the sitting room.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Lounge' looks like a room but is the verb; 'hang' looks like the definition but supplies letters.
explanation.definitionFit: To lollop can mean to lounge about idly, a sense recorded in Chambers alongside bounding clumsily.

clue.text: Nuts — one may find them on the table tomorrow

definitions.text: one may find them on the table tomorrow
definitions.meaning: second meaning: festive paper tubes pulled at Christmas dinner

explanation.walkthrough: The puzzle appeared on Christmas Eve, so tomorrow is Christmas Day, when British tables carry Christmas crackers, paper tubes that bang when pulled. 'Nuts' also suggests nutcrackers.
explanation.definitionFit: Crackers is British slang for insane, and crackers are also the novelty tubes laid at each place on the Christmas dinner table.

clue.text: Just one French fry? A lot should be cooked with a sausage

parts.note: a single French fry is a chip

indicators.note: cooking transforms ingredients, so these letters are reworked into a new order

parts.note: letters to be rearranged
the extra letter added to the rearrangement

explanation.surface: A single fry? Plenty more should be served up with a sausage.
explanation.walkthrough: 'A lot' and the later 'a' together are rearranged; 'with' joins definition to wordplay.
explanation.definitionFit: A chipolata is a small thin sausage, served with turkey at a British Christmas dinner.

clue.text: Pagans in extremely hostile capital city

indicators.note: extremely points to the extremes of the word, its first and last letters

parts.note: the first and last letters of hostile
Athens is the capital of Greece

explanation.surface: Unbelievers in an unfriendly capital.
explanation.definitionFit: Heathens are people who do not follow a major world religion, which is what pagans are.

clue.text: It's unimportant gossip about old maiden

indicators.note: about means around, so the word goes around the following pieces

parts.note: to natter is to chat or gossip
O is the abbreviation for old
M is the cricket abbreviation for a maiden over

explanation.surface: Tittle-tattle about some elderly spinster hardly matters.
explanation.definitionFit: 'No matter' is an idiom used to dismiss something as not worth worrying about.

clue.text: A crowning glory — if wrong I'm dead

indicators.note: wrong means not in the proper order, so the letters are rearranged

parts.note: the six letters to be rearranged

explanation.surface: A monarch's triumph, unless a fatal mistake is made.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Crowning glory' usually means a high point or a woman's hair; here it is literal headgear.
explanation.definitionFit: A diadem is a jewelled crown or headband, literally the glory that crowns a sovereign's head.

clue.text: Kind offer

definitions.meaning: second meaning: to put forward formally, as a bid

explanation.walkthrough: Read as a phrase it sounds like a generous proposal; the two words are separate meanings.
explanation.definitionFit: Tender is an adjective for gentle and loving, and a verb for formally offering a payment, bid or resignation.

clue.text: Blue feathers one noticed originally by the entrance

parts.note: down is soft fine feathers
the Roman numeral for one

indicators.note: originally points to the origin of the word, its opening letter

parts.note: the first letter of noticed
a mouth is an entrance, as of a cave or harbour

explanation.surface: A blue-feathered bird spotted at the doorway.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Blue' looks like a colour describing the feathers; it is the definition, meaning sad.
explanation.definitionFit: Down in the mouth is an idiom for dejected or sad, which is what blue means here.

clue.text: One river crossing Latin country

parts.note: the Roman numeral for one

indicators.note: a river crossing something stretches across it, so it surrounds the next piece

parts.note: the Tay is the longest river in Scotland
L is the abbreviation for Latin

explanation.surface: A single river flowing across the land of the Romans.
explanation.definitionFit: Italy is a country in southern Europe, the home of Latin.

clue.text: Good antique, a gift from a king

parts.note: G is the abbreviation for good
antique means old

explanation.surface: A fine old heirloom presented by royalty.
explanation.walkthrough: The kings are the Magi of the Nativity story, who brought gold, frankincense and myrrh.
explanation.definitionFit: Gold was one of the three gifts the Magi, traditionally kings, brought to the infant Jesus.

clue.text: Girl fighting enemy's leader in the dark

parts.note: Una is a girl's name
war is fighting

indicators.note: the leader of a word is the letter at its front

parts.note: the first letter of enemy

explanation.surface: A girl at war with a foe's commander under cover of night.
explanation.definitionFit: To be in the dark about something is an idiom for not knowing, so unaware.

clue.text: Top game

definitions.meaning: first meaning: a two-headed spinning top
second meaning: the juggling game played with it

explanation.walkthrough: 'Top game' reads as 'the best game'; 'top' is the spinning toy.
explanation.definitionFit: A diabolo is an hourglass-shaped spinning top, and the name also covers the game of whirling and tossing it on a string between two sticks.

clue.text: Bishop in important county

indicators.note: in places one piece inside the other

parts.note: key means crucial or important
RR stands for Right Reverend, a bishop's title

explanation.surface: A senior cleric holds sway in a significant shire.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Bishop' is usually B in chess; here it is RR, Right Reverend.
explanation.definitionFit: Kerry is a county in the south-west of Ireland.

clue.text: Dress up as comic, capped

indicators.note: comic means funny or absurd, so the letters are put into a ridiculous new order

parts.note: the nine letters to be rearranged

explanation.surface: Put on a clown's costume, complete with hat.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Capped' looks like wearing a cap; it means outdone, as in capping a joke.
explanation.definitionFit: To cap something is to outdo or top it, which is to surpass it.
